decisions.decision: Ms. Lincoln will look into plaques that store 100 names (orientation package; plaque order discussed).
decisions.quote: ms. lincoln will look into plaques that store 100 names.

decisions.decision: Council on Aging 55th celebration plan: police and fire members run the grill, Ms. Doherty rents tents and supplies tables and chairs, an ice cream truck and live music, Supporters to hold a fundraiser, Ms. Lincoln and a Select Board member to speak, and Ms. Doherty to invite the state delegation.
decisions.quote: members of the police and fire departments will run the grill, ms. doherty will rent tents, and supply tables and chairs.

budget_items.topic: Council on Aging 55th celebration: use of patio grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty will ask Supporters whether some of the patio grant can be used for the party instead.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty will ask supporters if she can use some of the $5,000 granted for the patio for the party instead.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An unofficial 2020 Census figure of 2,700 is reported; the minutes say it should boost formula grant funding by $7,000, and the Census numbers are not finalized.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty reported that 2020 census numbers have not been finalized, but an unofficial source comes in at 2,700, which should boost funding by $7,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Hannaford spare change fundraiser run by the Supporters brought in a reported amount.
budget_items.quote: the hannaford spare change fundraiser brought in $254.

ms. doherty will ask supporters if she can use some of the $5,000 granted for the patio for the party instead.

memorial day ceremony, monday may 30, 10:00 a.m. at veterans memorial park.
